representation: training-split componentwise StandardScaler only; no PCA, no PLS, no nonlinear feature transform
inverse_methods: EGC-GMR: evidence-gated competitive direct inverse analysis

egc_gmr.reliability_metric: GMR-specific Index of Extrapolation / log evidence from the fitted Gaussian mixture density; distinct from the kNN input-distance AD used for GPR, SVR, and Bayesian optimization
egc_gmr.feasibility_rule: discard candidates outside declared physical bounds; do not clip
egc_gmr.selection_rule: interleave model-specific candidates by calibrated support after covariance and diversity filtering
egc_gmr.rejection_rule: return unsupported_evidence if neither model exceeds its training-only shell threshold

inverse_matched_comparison.rule: compare all three methods only on targets accepted and simulator-verified for EGC-GMR; D7 retains accepted targets for input-space comparison only

variation_diagnostic.purpose: verify that conventional local-kernel predictions collapse to a constant, whereas the proposed forward model remains direction-dependent and EGC-GMR either returns direction-dependent direct inverse candidates or explicitly rejects targets outside its training-calibrated evidence support

limitations: Outer-domain truth is limited to the declared physical bounds.
EGC-GMR errors are conditional on targets accepted by the support gate; acceptance is reported separately.
IDAES CO2 uses five spatial elements and short adsorption/desorption horizons for tractability.
Concrete Slump candidates cannot be confirmed without new experiments; inverse response error is not reported.
Phase-field is an in-house finite-difference implementation, not MOOSE.

bayesian_optimization.acquisition: risk-adjusted UCB; exploration and discrepancy weights selected on the training-only outer shell
bayesian_optimization.ad_definition: mean k=5 nearest-neighbor distance in the training-standardized x space; boundary=Q90 of leave-one-out training scores
bayesian_optimization.risk_penalty: lambda*discrepancy_std + 0.05*max(rho-1,0)^2; kappa and lambda selected on training-only outer shell
bayesian_optimization.batch_rule: first acquisition maximum; subsequent maximin among top-40% acquisition candidates and above robust distance threshold; no fantasy observations

forward_applicability_domain.metric: mean k=5 nearest-neighbor distance in training-standardized x space
forward_applicability_domain.boundary: Q90 of leave-one-out training kNN distances

reviewer_driven_reanalysis.D5_status: exploratory because simulator-success filtering was non-uniform
reviewer_driven_reanalysis.bo_inference: Wilcoxon test on one median paired difference per dataset; repetitions are descriptive
reviewer_driven_reanalysis.uncertainty: coverage, interval width, RMSE, and proper interval score
